name: SuperNEMO
summary: SuperNEMO develops a modular tracking calorimeter for neutrinoless double-beta decay. Its demonstrator at Modane follows NEMO-3 while improving isotope loading, energy resolution and background control.
detection_principle: Thin enriched selenium foils are placed between gas tracking volumes and scintillator calorimeters. Two reconstructed electron tracks with a common vertex supply energy and angular information for signal and background discrimination.

status.label: Operating / data taking
status.evidence: The council report records official physics data taking from 10 April 2025 before the radon-free air factory. The October 2025 low-radon run and December 2026 end date are schedules in that report, not subsequently confirmed milestones.

timeline.event: Official start of physics data taking, initially without the LSM radon-free-air factory.

key_parameters.name: Source scale
key_parameters.value: Approximately 6-7 kg in the demonstrator design

results.summary: The collaboration documents demonstrator construction, commissioning and reconstruction work; the full modular design is distinct from the demonstrator.

science_scope: A neutrinoless double-beta-decay signal would establish lepton-number violation. Converting a half-life constraint into an effective Majorana mass requires a decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements; a null search is not a neutrino-mass measurement.
